channel.title: Aviral Srivastava: security findings
channel.description: Security engineer and researcher. Vulnerability research in AI infrastructure and systems: Langflow (CISA KEV), PHP-FPM, MCP SDKs, vLLM. Pwnie Awards 2026 nominee.

item.title: CVE-2026-129289: PHP. PHP-FPM request smuggling through an unread request body
item.description: Bytes an application never read were taken by PHP-FPM as the next request, one the web server never sent.

item.title: CVE-2026-104850: MCP TypeScript SDK. Stored OAuth credentials followed the server’s directions
item.description: The TypeScript client would present saved credentials to whichever authorization server an MCP server named.

item.title: CVE-2026-115563: MCP Python SDK. OAuth credentials sent to the wrong issuer
item.description: A malicious MCP server could tell the SDK’s OAuth client where to send credentials that were issued by someone else.

item.title: CVE-2026-73081: Activepieces. Command injection before the sandbox exists
item.description: The name of a code step ended up in a shell command on the worker host, at compile time.

item.title: CVE-2026-73083: Activepieces. V8 isolate bypass through module loading
item.description: User code was loaded with require() before the isolate applied, and loading a module runs it.

item.title: CVE-2026-73084: Activepieces. Reflected XSS in the OAuth redirect endpoint
item.description: The OAuth callback page wrote a query parameter straight into an inline script.

item.title: CVE-2026-69258: Flowise. Property injection into the flow execution context
item.description: An unauthenticated request could overwrite the session identity and variables a Flowise flow runs with.

item.title: CVE-2026-53923: vLLM. Cross-tenant GPU memory disclosure
item.description: A 32-bit element count in the GGUF kernels left part of a GPU buffer holding another request’s data.

item.title: CVE-2026-33017: Langflow. Unauthenticated remote code execution
item.description: One request with no login could run Python on the server behind an AI workflow platform.

item.title: CVE-2026-32628: AnythingLLM. SQL injection through an agent tool call
item.description: A table name chosen by the model, steered by the user, was pasted into a SQL query.
